subject: Staged cutover & integration questionnaire — Northbridge RFP
messages:
From: Tom Jackson <tom.jackson@northbridge.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Susan Li <susan.li@northbridge.com>, procurement@northbridge.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: RFP: Staged deployment questionnaire — integration & cutover windows

Hannah —

Thanks again for the demo last week. As part of our RFP packet, we need a detailed response to the implementation and cutover portion of the engagement. The procurement team attached a short questionnaire (see attached Northbridge_RFP_Q_A.xlsx) but we want to ensure the answers cover: timeline windows, integration touchpoints (APIs/webhooks), expected downtime or degraded performance during cutover, canary/pilot phasing, rollback criteria, and security/compliance gates.

High-level context: Northbridge will run the inference stack in a hybrid configuration — private peering into our VPC for PII paths and hosted for general routing. Our internal platform team has asked for a step-by-step staging plan that fits into a 12-week procurement-to-production window where week 1 is kickoff and week 8 is pilot start.

Can you provide:
- A proposed phased timeline with milestones and gating criteria
- Integration checklist (endpoints, auth, firewall rules, certs)
- Canary/pilot definition (traffic %, user cohorts, monitoring signals)
- Typical rollback steps and an estimate of RTO/RPO during a rollback

Would like to get a draft by next Tuesday (2026-12-08) so procurement can move forward. Happy to schedule a short 30-min sync if that helps.

Attachments: Northbridge_RFP_Q_A.xlsx (questionnaire spreadsheet)

Regards,
Tom Jackson
Principal IT Sourcing — Northbridge Financial

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Jackson <tom.jackson@northbridge.com>
Cc: Susan Li <susan.li@northbridge.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: RFP: Staged deployment questionnaire — integration & cutover windows

Tom —

Thanks for the clear list. We'll put together a concise staged cutover proposal that maps to your 12-week window. Marcus (SE) will draft the implementation runbook and I will own the timeline and gating language for procurement.

High-level takeaways (we will expand):
- Week 0–1: Kickoff, NDA/POC access, network validation (firewall/peering certs)
- Week 2–4: Integration & validation (API keys, webhooks, sample dataset runs)
- Week 5: Pilot prep and canary configuration (traffic split, monitoring hooks)
- Week 6–8: Pilot execution (start at 1% ramp to 10–15% per monitoring OK)
- Week 9–10: Gradual rollout to production cohorts (50% then 100%)
- Week 11–12: Post-rollout validation and closeout

We will include: endpoint list, auth patterns (mutual TLS + token rotation cadence), expected maintenance windows (none required for hot switchover but small degraded latencies possible during key migrations), and explicit rollback instructions.

Marcus — can you attach the detailed runbook and a canary schedule matrix?

Hannah Schmitt
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

+1 415-555-0162

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Tom Jackson <tom.jackson@northbridge.com>
Cc: Susan Li <susan.li@northbridge.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 14:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: RFP: Staged deployment questionnaire — integration & cutover windows

Tom / Hannah —

Attached is a detailed implementation runbook (redwood-implementation-runbook.md) and a condensed canary schedule table. Key items summarized below for procurement and platform review:

Prework (network & security):
- Validate VPC peering and BGP session tests; exchange IP allowlists and public key fingerprints
- Provide mTLS certs; enable mutual auth on integration endpoints
- Confirm KMS/HSM key policy for any customer-managed keys; provide audit log endpoints

Integration steps (APIs & data flow):
1) Create integration API keys scoped to dev/test namespaces (rotate every 30 days)
2) Provide sample payloads and schema; Redwood will run 10k synthetic requests against a staging model to validate latency and correctness
3) Enable prefix caching and KV migration: we recommend a pre-warm where we prime top 1,000 user prefixes into cache (script included)

Pilot / Canary plan:
- Canary cohort: 1% of total traffic (initial) for 48 hours with automated rollback if token-error rate > 0.5% or 95th latency increases > 50% over baseline
- Ramp: 1% -> 5% -> 15% over a 72-hour window with manual gatechecks at each step (metrics: error rate, 95/99 latency, cost per token, qualitative stake-holder signoff)
- Observability: logs shipped to your Splunk (or S3) + tracing span correlation keys; we will provide per-request IDs for sampling

Rollback and fallback options:
- Immediate fallback to hosted model endpoint (no data migration required) for traffic failover
- If rollback triggered during batch KV migration, run reverse-migration script and restore last-known-good checkpoint (approx. RTO 45–90 minutes depending on dataset size)
- Postmortem: within 24 hours we provide a root-cause and action items

Attachments: redwood-implementation-runbook.md (runbook, scripts), RFW-staged-cutover-schedule.pdf (canary matrix)

Let us know if you want the runbook converted to a gated checklist for your change management system.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Tom Jackson <tom.jackson@northbridge.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 10:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: RFP: Staged deployment questionnaire — integration & cutover windows

Tom / team —

Quick clarifications from a controls and SLA perspective before we finalize wording for procurement:
- Data residency: confirm which data paths carry PII and whether Northbridge expects logs containing user identifiers to be redacted. Our template supports redaction and field-level hashing; will you require config managed by Northbridge or Redwood?
- Audit logs retention: our standard is 90 days for high-fidelity logs and archived low-fidelity logs for 12 months. Procurement, do you need a longer retention window or on-prem archival?
- SLA exception windows: our targeted switchover RTO for a failed canary is 1–2 hours for traffic reroute; we can expand to a 30-minute SLO on an enterprise agreement.

If you can confirm the data-path classification and retention ask, we will bake the exact gating language into the schedule.

Grace O'Connor
Head of Product Compliance (acting)
grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Jackson <tom.jackson@northbridge.com>, Susan Li <susan.li@northbridge.com>, procurement@northbridge.com
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 08 Dec 2026 16:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: RFP: Staged deployment questionnaire — integration & cutover windows

Tom / Susan —

Attached is our proposed staged cutover deliverable tailored to the 12-week expectation (RFW-staged-cutover-schedule.pdf). We incorporated Marcus's runbook and Grace's compliance clarifications. Key asks for Northbridge to confirm so procurement can sign off:
- Data classification: please confirm whether the following streams are PII: auth logs, user message payloads, and session metadata. If yes, we will enable field-level hashing and ship redacted logs to your S3.
- Retention: confirm if 90/12 (90 days high-fidelity / 12 months low-fidelity) is acceptable or whether you require 24 months archival (additional fee).
- Acceptance gate: success criteria for pilot are (1) error rate <0.5% (2) 95th latency within +50% of baseline (3) two stakeholder signoffs from platform and product teams.

Next steps: if the above is acceptable, we propose a 30-min alignment call on Thu 2026-12-10 to walk procurement and platform through the canary matrix. After that we'll provide a final redlined statement of work for signature.

Attachments: RFW-staged-cutover-schedule.pdf
Links: https://hubspot.company/record/NB-4321 (deal record), https://drive.company/shared/nb-rfp/implementation-runbook

Thanks — looking forward to getting you into pilot.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
